The educator roundtable

Bringing educators and school leaders together to discuss the role of AI in high school education.

School of ICT, Griffith University and A B Paterson College: AI in high school education

Griffith University’s ICT School Head, Prof. Alan Liew, and the Principal of A B Paterson College, Ms. Joanne Sheehy, invited key members from their respective teams to discuss how AI could help in high school education.
